messages:
maya-sales: Kickoff thread — Auriga perf POC. Need short runnable plan: throughput + tail latency tests, instrumentation to attribute latency (app vs network vs KMS/HSM), and a quick pricing ballpark. Customer wants results within 48h. Workload: steady 100 qps, spikes up to 1k qps. Model variant: gpt-open-6b-qa (approx). Any blockers?

liam-se: Got it. Checklist: loadgen config, warmup strategy, tracing spans, KMS toggle, acceptance criteria. Do we have sample prompt/response lengths?

maya-sales: They said avg prompt ~75 tokens, gen ~150 tokens. Convo-like patterns, variable lengths. They'll share security questionnaire. KMS + SOC2 flagged.

sanjay-eng: Plan recs: 30m warmup at 100 qps with mixed seq lengths. Capture p50/p95/p99, GPU util, cpu, KV cache hit rate, batch sizes and queueing. Instrumentation: add X-Req-Id + tags (model_variant, route). For KMS perf delta: run with KMS off then on. Quick loadgen config:

```yaml
loadgen:
  concurrency: 100
  burst_profile:
    - duration: 120s
      qps: 1000
  seq_len_distribution:
    prompt_mean: 75
    generate_mean: 150
  warmup: 1800s
  headers:
    - X-Req-Id
    - Traceparent
```

kelly-sec: For security: need KMS vendor, whether they require HSM-backed keys, envelope encryption approach, and VPC peering egress rules. Note: per-token HSM signing adds ~>10ms.

nora-ops: Pricing ballpark for initial POC: hosted: ~$0.30 per 1k generated tokens (rough), Dedicated: estimate 2x A100-equivalent GPUs for steady 100 qps (depends on batch/quant). I'll produce a quick spreadsheet after bench run.

liam-se: Add canary test: route 5% of traffic to Dedicated variant and compare p99 & cost. Steps:
1) Warmup 30m
2) Steady 60m @100 qps
3) 3x burst tests (2m @1k qps)
4) Toggle KMS on/off
5) Collect traces + perf counters

maya-sales: Auriga wants Thu 09:00 PT. SRE window OK?

sanjay-eng: Fine. Need allowlist IPs and sample S3 + prompt set. I'll also enable KV cache metrics and continuous batching logs on bench cluster.

deploy-bot: bench-runner: bench-cluster-3 created, bench-001 node ready :white_check_mark:

kelly-sec: Also ask Auriga: do logs contain any PII? if yes, enable redaction + shorter retention for logs used in bench.

nora-ops: Quick cost calc note (for internal): tokens/request ~225 => tokens/sec @100qps = 22,500 tps. Monthly (30d) = 22.5k * 3600 * 24 * 30 ≈ 58,320,000,000 tokens (~58B). Use that for monthly extrapolated quote.

liam-se: Acceptance criteria proposal:
- Hosted: p99 <= 280ms at steady 100 qps
- Dedicated: p99 <= 180ms at steady 100 qps
- Burst: p99 <= 500ms for 2m at 1k qps
- KV cache hit rate >= 60% after warmup
- No KMS-induced >10% latency regression when enabled

maya-sales: I'll forward the security questionnaire and S3 link. Can someone draft the short exec summary (1 page) after run? :thumbsup:

sanjay-eng: Yep, I'll write the exec summary with charts (p50/p95/p99, batch distribution, GPU util, cost estimate). Expect it within 6h after bench.

kelly-sec: I'll draft the security notes for the questionnaire (KMS, HSM impact, network controls) and attach.

maya-sales: Awesome — thanks team. I'll keep Auriga updated and post the dataset once I have it.
